title: Amazing app and incredible team ❤️
body:
I’ve always loved this app for how it helps me stay motivated and build better habits. The features are incredibly well-designed, and I especially love the graphs that allow me to easily track my progress over time..

But what makes it even more special is the kindness and understanding of the team behind it. I had trouble accessing the premium version due to payment limitations in my region, so I reached out to them and they actually listened and helped me… something I never expected 🥹

This isn’t just a great app; it’s made by people who genuinely care about their users. Thank you so much for making this possible for me! 🙏🏻❤️

I highly recommend Habit tracker to anyone looking to build strong habits and stay on track.
author: Asma246

title: Very friendly app
body: Super user friendly app that you can adapt to in a matter of minutes. The design, the colors and logic in the app, everything works perfectly fine.  I’ve been searching for an app like this one for a while and this is exactly what I was looking for.
